# 1000 Trees Holiday Homes (हजार झाडांचं गांव), Dapoli

> An NA plotting and bungalow project at Dapoli, Ratnagiri district, Maharashtra, India. 74 plots from 2,000 sq ft, each with mango, cashew, parijatak and sonchafa trees, a water connection and MSEB power. Over 1,000 trees planted across the project using the Miyawaki method. Adjacent to the developer's earlier Resort Dapoli project.

## Key facts

- 74 NA plots, launched February 2025
- Plot sizes 2,000 sq ft and 3,000 sq ft plus
- Indicative rate around Rs 800 per sq ft, subject to change
- Water and MSEB power to every individual plot
- Two farm ponds harvesting roughly 7 lakh litres of rainwater
- Nearest beach: Kolthare, about 9 km
- Approx 230 km from Mumbai, 215 km from Pune; Khed railway station about 40 km
- Bank loan available for plot and bungalow
- Documents: government NA order, sanctioned NA plan, individual 7/12 extract, registered sale deed, MSEB sanction, approved bungalow construction plan, Grampanchayat house number
- Amenities: central kitchen, housekeeping, onsite maintenance, mini golf, life size chess, green gym, library, children's park, temples, yoga deck
- Contact: WhatsApp Kedar +91 77740 31242
